commands: .venv/bin/uv --cache-dir /tmp/vsa/uv-cache run --no-project --with fonttools --with brotli fonttools varLib.instancer assets/brand/fonts/Fraunces.ttf wght=500 SOFT=0 WONK=1 --output /tmp/vsa/Fraunces.ttf

.venv/bin/uv --cache-dir /tmp/vsa/uv-cache run --no-project --with fonttools --with brotli fonttools varLib.instancer assets/brand/fonts/IBMPlexSans.ttf wght=400:500 wdth=100 --output /tmp/vsa/IBMPlexSans.ttf

.venv/bin/uv --cache-dir /tmp/vsa/uv-cache run --no-project --with fonttools --with brotli python - <<'PY'
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
font = TTFont("assets/brand/fonts/IBMPlexSans.woff2")
for record in font["name"].names:
    if record.nameID in (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 16, 17, 21, 22, 25) or record.nameID >= 256:
        value = record.toUnicode().replace("IBM Plex Sans", "Vej Sans").replace("IBMPlexSans", "VejSans")
        assert "plex" not in value.lower(), (record.nameID, value)
        record.string = value.encode(record.getEncoding())
assert all("plex" not in record.toUnicode().lower() for record in font["name"].names)
font.recalcTimestamp = False
font.save("assets/brand/fonts/VejSans.woff2")
PY
